newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian peso closes slightly lower.
newsitem.headline: Colombian peso closes slightly lower.

text.p: Colombia's peso closed well off its intraday low of 1.046.50 to the dollar, but barely moved from the previous day's close in quiet interbank trading.
The peso, which hit a high of 1,043.20, closed at 1,044.20, down just 20 centavos from Tuesday's close.

Dealers said there was early speculation about a flood of dollars entering the market because of the purchase on Tuesday of a 40 percent stake in Banco Ganadero by Spain's Banco Bilbao Vizcaya. But the central bank -- worried that a sudden influx of foreign currency would drive the peso sharply higher -- authorized Ganadero to temporarily exceed its legal limit on foreign reserves and keep about $205 million of the share buyout off the market.
A stronger peso makes Colombian exports more expensive abroad and there have been growing protests in recent weeks in the face of the peso's rise from 1,070 in late June.
Adding to downward pressure on the peso, dealers say most banks have been withholding dollars from the interbank market this week in a typical month-end move to limit foreign exchange losses.
Dealers reported 385 trades during Wednesday's session for a total of $162 million.
